ModMetaData.name: Site-44
ModMetaData.author: jerbtrundles
ModMetaData.description:
Procedurally generated ruined complexes to explore and loot: office campuses, hospitals, barracks bases, research compounds, industrial plants and residential blocks. Each is a believable abandoned building with real hallways, furnished and decayed rooms, loot crates, cryosleep caskets, locked secure rooms and the odd prototype droid.
Offered as world-map quest sites in five sizes, or start inside one with the Site-44 Breach scenario. Needs only the base game and uses no Harmony patches.
Tune everything under Options, Mod settings, Site-44.
